name: tip
title: Tip
description: The quiet line of help that sits in the layout rather than over it. A coach mark interrupts, pulses and is the step a sequence is on; a tip is a sentence a player can read or ignore, and it is the right component whenever the guidance is not worth a bubble. It never holds focus, dismissal is a state rather than an unmount so `data-gs-dismissed="true"` is assertable, and it binds no Escape handler because a page full of tips would make Escape mean several things at once. Floats only when given `data-gs-placement`, and placement is CSS driven by the attribute rather than a positioning library.
docs: Render it where the guidance belongs and pass nothing: inline is the normal case, and the absent `placement` is what keeps it in the flow. Pass `placement` only when the host wants it to float, in which case it positions against the nearest positioned ancestor. Pass `anchor` when the tip is about one control. Pass `dismissed` and `onDismiss` as a controlled pair; without `onDismiss` there is no close control and the tip cannot be closed. Reach for `coach-mark` instead when the guidance has to interrupt, point, or carry a step.
